scene_description: A young child wearing a cream-colored coat and jeans sits outdoors among fallen autumn leaves. The child is holding out their hand toward a small white squirrel, appearing to offer it food. The ground is covered with orange and yellow leaves.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the child's hand reaching toward the squirrel.

questions.question: Where is the child sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is on the ground all around the child.

questions.question: What is the squirrel doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the squirrel's body and where it is facing.

questions.question: What might the squirrel do next?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at how close the squirrel is to the child's hand.
